goal: Cut the active equipment and SimC summary consumers from synchronous legacy Gear stats to the canonical asynchronous stat-snapshot API with bounded race-safe polling.
userValue: Complete equipment configurations show trustworthy verified character stats without holding an HTTP request open for SimulationCraft, while edits and stale responses remain safe.
nonGoals: No backend API, PostgreSQL schema, worker, systemd or deploy-script changes
No removal of the legacy /api/websim/gear/stats route
No DPS, optimizer, recommendation or public-template change

mustChange: one structured async stat-snapshot API client wrapper
pure begin/apply/poll/stale transitions guarded by request serial and Intent version
bounded polling with at most 15 attempts and 45 seconds
equipment detail stat refresh sends only selectionIntent plus allowlisted profileContext
SimC summary stat refresh uses the same async contract
intent, template, race or scenario changes cancel or supersede old polls
200 verified updates the stat surface while 202, 409, 503 and offline remain truthful
no active frontend call site invokes requestWebsimGearStats after cutover
mustNotChange: Resolver-owned legality, readiness, set and serializer facts
save/Profile/SimC gates or legacy template compatibility fields except the stat transport
backend route, store, worker and one-child execution
evidenceRequired: bounded attempt and wall-clock stop tests
last verified snapshot preservation during pending/unavailable state
both active consumer call sites use canonical bodies and no legacy stat wrapper
frontend/full profiles, local CR and exact-head GitHub Harness
real mini-program pending-to-verified and changed-input stale suppression evidence
candidate backend health, public/Catalyst/timer/log and rollback proof
clean-main post-merge mini-program and API smoke

ownership.factOwner: server verified stat snapshot envelope; pages/builds/gear-workbench-state.js owns only request ordering and presentation state

engineeringHealth.reason: The live worker contract is already candidate and post-merge verified; this slice is safe only if polling, cancellation and last-verified behavior are pure and both consumers share the same wrapper.

acceptanceEvidence: real mini-program pending-to-verified, changed-input stale suppression and candidate API/health/public/Catalyst/timer/log smoke

decisionLog.decision: Polling starts at the server retryAfterMs hint, is capped at 15 attempts and 45 seconds, and is superseded by any newer request identity.
Pending and unavailable states may preserve the last verified snapshot for stale read-only display but never relabel it as current.
Both equipment detail and SimC summary use one canonical wrapper; the legacy wrapper remains only for older clients and compatibility tests.
